attempts.url: no vendor OpenAPI; Google Sheets API v4 publishes a Discovery document

notes: Full coverage of the Google Sheets API v4, converted from the verbatim Google API Discovery document (revision 20260626) committed as upstream.json. Every resource method (17 operations) and every Discovery schema (262 components) is modelled. The googlesheets adaptor calls this API through the googleapis SDK; the whole API is described here (not just the adaptor's operations) so a workflow can reach any endpoint via the generic builders.
